name: Heartland Beef
blurb: One big packing plant in Prairie Bend, 1,400 line workers, and about 600 ranches that sell it cattle. Founder Walt Dreyer started as a rancher and still holds 28% of the vote. The ranchers' co-op sells Heartland most of its herds.

exposure.text: Disbarred if the board is caught hiding facts while she sits on it.

secrets.text: Never be on a board that's caught hiding facts.
Your firm earns fees when regulators look into Heartland. A hidden fact that comes out keeps the fees coming.

exposure.text: Loses the next union vote if line wages are frozen.

secrets.text: The old ammonia system gets replaced before the game ends.
You were granted stock options last year. The stock must end above where it started.

exposure.text: Investors pull money from his fund if the stock ends below where it started.

secrets.text: Pass a buyback of $30M or more in any round.
Your fund quietly owns a rival packer. Heartland's stock must finish in the bottom half.

directors.name: Gus Halvorsen
directors.title: Founder's friend
directors.home: Walt Dreyer, the founder (hunting partner of 30 years)

exposure.text: Loses the seat if the board votes down the wage freeze Walt wants.

secrets.text: Walt signed off on keeping the ammonia near-miss quiet. Make sure the board never admits every fact about it.
Walt's name is on the cancellation clause. No fact about it may ever be caught.

exposure.text: Faces a no-confidence vote at home if contracts are cancelled on small ranchers.

secrets.text: Either the rancher bonus or the hardship loans pass.
You run a 4,000-head feedlot that would pick up cancelled contracts. Get the cancellations through.

motions.title: Stock buyback
motions.motive: Hand the cash back to the owners, and the market will notice tonight.

motions.title: Replace the ammonia cooling system
motions.motive: The old system is forty years old and due for replacement.

motions.title: Pay ranchers a bonus on this year's cattle
motions.motive: They carry the weather and the feed bills. Share the good year.

issue.text: Last month an ammonia line at the plant sprang a leak. Nobody was hurt, the floor cleared for twenty minutes, and nobody reported it to the regulator.

facts.text: An ammonia line at the plant sprang a leak last month.
The floor was cleared for twenty minutes.
Nobody reported it to the regulator.
The cooling system has not been replaced.

motions.title: Cancel contracts with small ranchers
motions.motive: The contract allows it. Small herds cost the most to collect.

motions.title: Freeze line wages
motions.motive: No raises until the market comes back.

motions.title: Hardship loans for small ranchers
motions.motive: Help the small herds make it through the year.

issue.text: A clause in the small-rancher contracts lets Heartland cancel on 30 days' notice, and most ranchers have not read it.

facts.text: Small-rancher contracts let Heartland cancel on 30 days' notice.
Most ranchers have not read the clause.
The clause has been in contracts since 2019.
